_comment: The ledger evidence gate's pass table (M1b PR 5b; docs/plans/m1b_ledger_evidence_gate.md, 'PR 5b build spec'). Read from the MERGE-BASE: an entry added in the same PR supports nothing. kind -> rows it may support, targets (new status token -> the verdict values that support it), require (dotted field -> exact value on the verdict), and for a kind with a code-owned complete-run rule (scripts/_evidence_records.py::COMPLETE_RULES) its `complete` block: the frozen sets / pins the rule checks, pinned to each harness's FROZEN by tests/unit/test_lint_evidence_gate.py. scopes (#1141): the ledger qualifier heads (`narrow`, `rung X`; null = the unqualified claim) a verdict of this kind supports; new support must match the row's HEAD qualifier head exactly (no subsumption), a merge-base entry without `scopes` supports nothing, a new scope acts only once the table edit is on main, and a kind with a complete-run rule supports exactly one scope and keeps it (a new scope on a ruled kind is a new kind). A token not listed is not supported. REPRODUCED (O19 kinds only, #1059): a SUCCESSOR campaign's verdict, only on byte-identical subject code; a root campaign's never (the gate reads which from the merge-base campaign table).
